A 24-hour build, from idea to prototype

HackFest is a 24-hour hackathon for student teams. Participants form teams of up to three, pick a problem, and spend a day and a night turning an idea into something that works.

The poster presents it as a collaboration between VIT Chennai and SRM Institute, Kattankulathur, under the lines Code, Collaborate, Create and Turn your ideas into real solutions.

This is an independently created information site for the event. It is not an official website of VIT Chennai or SRM Institute. Tracks, prizes and judging details are not on the poster, so none are listed here.
